from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import date
import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import pytest

from trialops.privacy import export_subjects


ON = date(2024, 6, 15)


def make_subject(subject_id="subject-one", **changes):
    record = {
        "id": subject_id,
        "name": "Fictional Person",
        "birth_date": "1990-04-03",
        "email": "person@example.test",
        "country": "NZ",
        "visits": ["2024-05-01", "2024-01-02"],
        "consents": [{"purpose": "research", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        "purge_after": "2024-06-15",
    }
    record.update(changes)
    return record


def pseudonym(subject_id, *, purpose="research", secret="test-secret"):
    message = f"{purpose}:{subject_id}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )


def test_active_boundaries_sorting_schema_and_canonical_manifest():
    subjects = [make_subject("subject-b"), make_subject("subject-a")]
    original = deepcopy(subjects)

    result = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)

    expected_rows = [
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-a"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],
        },
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-b"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],
        },
    ]
    expected_rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["pseudonym"])
    assert result["rows"] == expected_rows
    assert result["manifest"] == {
        "algorithm": "sha256",
        "count": 2,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(expected_rows).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
    }
    assert subjects == original


def test_withdrawal_on_on_is_inactive_but_later_withdrawal_is_active():

def test_full_workflow_normalizes_history_and_deep_copies():
    original = request(history=[{"action": "imported", "nested": {"value": 1}}])
    snapshot = deepcopy(original)
    executor_calls = []

    def executor(approved_request):
        executor_calls.append(approved_request)
        approved_request["metadata"]["quality_score"] = 0
        return {"rows": 3}

    submitted = apply_reuse_action(original, "submit", "alice", NOW)
    assert original == snapshot
    assert submitted is not original
    assert submitted["metadata"] is not original["metadata"]
    assert submitted["history"][0] is not original["history"][0]
    assert submitted["history"][-1] == {
        "action": "submit",
        "actor": "alice",
        "at": "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    }

    approved = apply_reuse_action(submitted, "approve", "bob", NOW + timedelta(days=1))
    assert approved["approval_expires_on"] == "2025-02-01"
    executed = apply_reuse_action(
        approved, "execute", "alice", NOW + timedelta(days=2), executor
    )
    assert executed["status"] == "executed"
    assert executed["execution_result"] == {"rows": 3}
    assert len(executor_calls) == 1
    assert executor_calls[0]["status"] == "approved"
    assert approved["status"] == "approved"
    assert approved["metadata"]["quality_score"] == 0.95
    assert "execution_result" not in approved
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in executed["history"][-3:]] == [
        "submit",
        "approve",
        "execute",
    ]

        "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z",
        "2025-01-02T12:00:00Z",
        "2025-01-03T12:00:00Z",
    ]

    purge_yesterday = make_subject("purge-yesterday", purge_after="2024-06-14")
    other_purpose = make_subject(

        consents=[{"purpose": "marketing", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}],
    )
    withdrawn_earlier = make_subject(
        "withdrawn-earlier",
        consents=[

    result = export_subjects(

    assert [row["pseudonym"] for row in result["rows"]] == expected

def test_output_is_deterministic_and_independent_of_input_order():
    subjects = [
        make_subject(
            f"subject-{index}",
            consents=[
                {"purpose": "research", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"},
                {"purpose": "safety", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"},
            ],
        )
        for index in range(6)
    ]

    first = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)
    again = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)
    reordered = export_subjects(
        (record for record in reversed(deepcopy(subjects))),
        purpose="research",
        secret="test-secret",
        on=ON,
    )

    assert first == again == reordered
    assert canonical(first) == canonical(reordered)
    pseudonyms = [row["pseudonym"] for row in first["rows"]]
    assert pseudonyms == sorted(pseudonyms)
    assert len(set(pseudonyms)) == 6
    for value in pseudonyms:
        assert len(value) == 16
        assert set(value) <= set("0123456789abcdef")

    other_secret = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="research", secret="other-secret", on=ON
    )
    other_purpose = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="safety", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )
    assert set(pseudonyms).isdisjoint(row["pseudonym"] for row in other_secret["rows"])
    assert set(pseudonyms).isdisjoint(row["pseudonym"] for row in other_purpose["rows"])
    assert sorted(row["pseudonym"] for row in other_purpose["rows"]) == sorted(
        pseudonym(f"subject-{index}", purpose="safety") for index in range(6)
    )


def test_canonical_hash_is_utf8_without_ascii_escapes():
    result = export_subjects(
        [make_subject("subject-one", country="Åland")],
        purpose="research",
        secret="test-secret",
        on=ON,
    )

    rows = result["rows"]
    assert rows[0]["country"] == "Åland"
    text = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "\\u" not in text
    assert text.startswith('[{"birth_year":1990,"country":"Åland","pseudonym":"')
    assert result["manifest"]["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(
        text.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    escaped = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    assert result["manifest"]["sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(
        escaped.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()

class TrackedSubjects:
    """Iterable that records how often it has been consumed."""

    def __init__(self, records):
        self._records = records
        self.iterations = 0

    def __iter__(self):
        self.iterations += 1
        return iter(self._records)

def test_execute_reuse_export_end_to_end_through_governance():
    draft = make_request("draft", purpose="safety")
    submitted = apply_reuse_action(draft, "submit", "alice", NOW - timedelta(days=2))
    approved = apply_reuse_action(submitted, "approve", "bob", NOW - timedelta(days=1))
    approved_snapshot = deepcopy(approved)

    subjects = [
        make_subject(
            "sensitive-id",
            consents=[{"purpose": "safety", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        ),
        make_subject(
            "second-id",
            consents=[{"purpose": "safety", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}],
            country="AU",
        ),
        make_subject("research-only"),
    ]
    subjects_snapshot = deepcopy(subjects)

    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved, subjects, actor="alice", secret="test-secret", now=NOW
    )

    expected_export = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="safety", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )
    assert expected_export["manifest"]["count"] == 2
    assert executed["execution_result"] == expected_export
    assert [row["pseudonym"] for row in executed["execution_result"]["rows"]] == sorted(
        [
            pseudonym("sensitive-id", purpose="safety"),
            pseudonym("second-id", purpose="safety"),
        ]
    )
    assert executed["status"] == "executed"
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in executed["history"]] == [
        "submit",
        "approve",
        "execute",
    ]
    assert executed["history"][-1] == {
        "action": "execute",
        "actor": "alice",
        "at": "2024-06-15T12:00:00Z",
    }
    # Everything but the execution outcome is carried over from the approval.
    carried_over = {
        key: value
        for key, value in executed.items()
        if key not in ("status", "history", "execution_result")
    }
    assert carried_over == {
        key: value
        for key, value in approved_snapshot.items()
        if key not in ("status", "history")
    }
    assert executed["history"][:-1] == approved_snapshot["history"]

    assert approved == approved_snapshot
    assert subjects == subjects_snapshot
    assert_no_direct_identifiers(canonical(executed))
    for subject_id in ("second-id", "research-only"):
        assert subject_id not in canonical(executed)

def test_execute_reuse_export_delegates_exactly_once(monkeypatch):
    governance_calls = []
    export_calls = []
    real_apply = privacy.apply_reuse_action
    real_export = privacy.export_subjects

    def spy_apply(*args, **kwargs):
        governance_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_apply(*args, **kwargs)

    def spy_export(*args, **kwargs):
        export_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_export(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "apply_reuse_action", spy_apply)
    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "export_subjects", spy_export)

    approved = make_request()
    subjects = TrackedSubjects([make_subject("sensitive-id")])
    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved, subjects, actor="alice", secret="test-secret", now=NOW
    )

    assert len(governance_calls) == 1
    args, kwargs = governance_calls[0]
    assert len(args) == 4
    assert args[0] is approved
    assert args[1:] == ("execute", "alice", NOW)
    assert set(kwargs) == {"executor"}
    assert callable(kwargs["executor"])

    assert len(export_calls) == 1
    args, kwargs = export_calls[0]
    assert len(args) == 1 and args[0] is subjects
    assert kwargs == {"purpose": "research", "secret": "test-secret", "on": ON}
    assert subjects.iterations == 1
    assert executed["execution_result"] == real_export(
        subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )

def test_export_failures_roll_back_to_the_approved_request(records, secret):
    approved = make_request(history=[{"action": "approve", "actor": "bob"}])
    snapshot = deepcopy(approved)
    records_snapshot = deepcopy(records)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        execute_reuse_export(
            approved, records, actor="alice", secret=secret, now=NOW

    assert str(caught.value) == "EXECUTION_FAILED"
    cause = caught.value.__cause__

    assert_no_direct_identifiers(str(cause))

    assert approved["status"] == "approved"
    assert "execution_result" not in approved
    assert approved["history"] == [{"action": "approve", "actor": "bob"}]
    assert records == records_snapshot

    # The untouched approval can still be executed once the export is fixed.
    retried = execute_reuse_export(
        approved,
        [make_subject("sensitive-id")],
        actor="alice",
        secret="test-secret",
        now=NOW,
    )
    assert retried["status"] == "executed"
    assert retried["execution_result"]["manifest"]["count"] == 1
    assert approved == snapshot
